cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Approve the Cover Story
cards.instruction: Get someone to endorse an explanation that protects the plan, reputation, or people involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll submit the hall request. Back 'collecting chairs' if the caretaker asks why we opened his props cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Checking for folding stools, then. I'll write it that way if you'll sign.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you admit you borrowed his key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put that in: borrowed his key to check for extra seating. Sign beside me.

reason: Lead with the real submission task; A changes the explanation and accepts key disclosure to retain B joint backing, without additional rank statements.
